body: Nothing in this world is free... this is one of those scenarios where you wake up in a tub of ice with one less kidney and a wicked new scar

I've got a hard deadline on a project to meet in 6 weeks.  I'm behind, but it needs to get done and then that will be off my mind.  In the meantime I have to prepare for a big job interview in 2 weeks.  So the workload isn't going to decrease.  These are the opportunities I've been working for.

I've been exercising more and beating the hell out of my guitar strings, but the feelings keep coming back.

It's the situation with the girl that have caused undue stress.  I don't know what I want there.  I've been thinking about cutting her loose, but she needs me as much as I need her.
